<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Brick Breaker</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #111; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: sans-serif; }
  canvas { background: #1b1f2a; border: 2px solid #444; cursor: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="game" width="640" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;

const LEVELS = [
  // Level 1: simple rows
  [
    "1111111111",
    "1111111111",
    "2222222222",
    "2222222222",
  ],
  // Level 2: pattern with tougher bricks (3 = 2 hits)
  [
    "3333333333",
    "1.1.11.1.1",
    "2222222222",
    "3.3333333.3".slice(0, 10),
    "1111111111",
    "2.2.22.2.2",
  ],
];
const COLORS = { 1: '#4fc3f7', 2: '#81c784', 3: '#ff8a65' };

const paddle = { w: 90, h: 12, x: W / 2 - 45, y: H - 30, speed: 7 };
const ball = { r: 7, x: 0, y: 0, dx: 0, dy: 0, stuck: true };
const keys = { left: false, right: false };

let bricks = [];
let level = 0, score = 0, lives = 3;
let state = 'start'; // start | playing | levelclear | gameover | win

function buildLevel(n) {
  bricks = [];
  const rows = LEVELS[n];
  const cols = 10, pad = 6, top = 50, side = 20;
  const bw = (W - side * 2 - pad * (cols - 1)) / cols, bh = 20;
  rows.forEach((row, r) => {
    for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
      const ch = row[c];
      if (!ch || ch === '.') continue;
      const t = +ch;
      bricks.push({ x: side + c * (bw + pad), y: top + r * (bh + pad), w: bw, h: bh, hits: t === 3 ? 2 : 1, type: t, alive: true });
    }
  });
}

function resetBall() {
  ball.stuck = true;
  ball.dx = 0; ball.dy = 0;
  paddle.x = W / 2 - paddle.w / 2;
}

function launch() {
  if (!ball.stuck) return;
  const speed = 5 + level * 1;
  const angle = (Math.random() * 0.6 - 0.3) - Math.PI / 2;
  ball.dx = speed * Math.cos(angle);
  ball.dy = speed * Math.sin(angle);
  ball.stuck = false;
}

function newGame() {
  level = 0; score = 0; lives = 3;
  buildLevel(level); resetBall();
  state = 'playing';
}

function action() {
  if (state === 'start' || state === 'gameover' || state === 'win') newGame();
  else if (state === 'levelclear') { level++; buildLevel(level); resetBall(); state = 'playing'; }
  else if (state === 'playing') launch();
}

// Keyboard
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') keys.left = true;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') keys.right = true;
  if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); action(); }
});
document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') keys.left = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') keys.right = false;
});

// Mouse
canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = (e.clientX - rect.left) * (W / rect.width);
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, mx - paddle.w / 2));
});
canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', action);

function update() {
  if (state !== 'playing') return;

  if (keys.left) paddle.x -= paddle.speed;
  if (keys.right) paddle.x += paddle.speed;
  paddle.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - paddle.w, paddle.x));

  if (ball.stuck) {
    ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
    ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
    return;
  }

  // Substeps to avoid tunneling
  const steps = 3;
  for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
    ball.x += ball.dx / steps;
    ball.y += ball.dy / steps;

    // Walls
    if (ball.x - ball.r < 0) { ball.x = ball.r; ball.dx = Math.abs(ball.dx); }
    if (ball.x + ball.r > W) { ball.x = W - ball.r; ball.dx = -Math.abs(ball.dx); }
    if (ball.y - ball.r < 0) { ball.y = ball.r; ball.dy = Math.abs(ball.dy); }

    // Paddle
    if (ball.dy > 0 && ball.y + ball.r >= paddle.y && ball.y + ball.r <= paddle.y + paddle.h + ball.dy &&
        ball.x >= paddle.x - ball.r && ball.x <= paddle.x + paddle.w + ball.r) {
      const hit = (ball.x - (paddle.x + paddle.w / 2)) / (paddle.w / 2); // -1..1
      const speed = Math.hypot(ball.dx, ball.dy);
      const angle = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, hit)) * (Math.PI / 3);
      ball.dx = speed * Math.sin(angle);
      ball.dy = -speed * Math.cos(angle);
      ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r;
    }

    // Bricks
    for (const b of bricks) {
      if (!b.alive) continue;
      const cx = Math.max(b.x, Math.min(ball.x, b.x + b.w));
      const cy = Math.max(b.y, Math.min(ball.y, b.y + b.h));
      const ddx = ball.x - cx, ddy = ball.y - cy;
      if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy <= ball.r * ball.r) {
        // Determine bounce axis by overlap
        const overlapX = Math.min(ball.x + ball.r - b.x, b.x + b.w - (ball.x - ball.r));
        const overlapY = Math.min(ball.y + ball.r - b.y, b.y + b.h - (ball.y - ball.r));
        if (overlapX < overlapY) ball.dx = -ball.dx; else ball.dy = -ball.dy;
        b.hits--;
        if (b.hits <= 0) { b.alive = false; score += b.type * 10; }
        else score += 5;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Fell below
    if (ball.y - ball.r > H) {
      lives--;
      if (lives <= 0) { state = 'gameover'; }
      else resetBall();
      return;
    }
  }

  if (bricks.every(b => !b.alive)) {
    state = level + 1 < LEVELS.length ? 'levelclear' : 'win';
  }
}

function drawText(text, y, size = 28, color = '#fff') {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.font = `bold ${size}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(text, W / 2, y);
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // HUD
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 12, 24);
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('Level: ' + (level + 1) + ' / ' + LEVELS.length, W / 2, 24);
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('Lives: ' + '❤'.repeat(Math.max(0, lives)), W - 12, 24);

  // Bricks
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.type === 3 && b.hits === 1 ? '#bf360c' : COLORS[b.type];
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, b.w, b.h);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.35)';
    ctx.strokeRect(b.x + 0.5, b.y + 0.5, b.w - 1, b.h - 1);
  }

  // Paddle
  ctx.fillStyle = '#eceff1';
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, paddle.y, paddle.w, paddle.h);

  // Ball
  if (state === 'playing' || state === 'start') {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffeb3b';
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Overlays
  if (state === 'start') {
    drawText('BRICK BREAKER', H / 2 - 20, 40);
    drawText('Move: Mouse or ← → / A D', H / 2 + 20, 18, '#ccc');
    drawText('Click or press Space to start', H / 2 + 50, 18, '#ccc');
  } else if (state === 'playing' && ball.stuck) {
    drawText('Click or press Space to launch', H / 2 + 60, 18, '#ccc');
  } else if (state === 'levelclear') {
    drawText('LEVEL ' + (level + 1) + ' CLEAR!', H / 2, 36, '#81c784');
    drawText('Click or press Space for next level', H / 2 + 40, 18, '#ccc');
  } else if (state === 'gameover') {
    drawText('GAME OVER', H / 2, 40, '#ef5350');
    drawText('Final score: ' + score, H / 2 + 36, 20);
    drawText('Click or press Space to restart', H / 2 + 66, 18, '#ccc');
  } else if (state === 'win') {
    drawText('YOU WIN!', H / 2, 40, '#ffeb3b');
    drawText('Final score: ' + score, H / 2 + 36, 20);
    drawText('Click or press Space to play again', H / 2 + 66, 18, '#ccc');
  }
}

function loop() {
  update();
  draw();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

buildLevel(0);
resetBall();
ball.x = paddle.x + paddle.w / 2;
ball.y = paddle.y - ball.r - 1;
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  level = 0; score = 0; lives = 3;

I wrote the brick-breaker game to `index.html` in the current folder. It's a single file with no other dependencies, and you play it by opening it in a browser. I didn't open it in a browser to test it.

- **Levels:** Level 1 has 4 rows of bricks. Level 2 has 6 rows with gaps, and its orange bricks take 2 hits. The ball starts a bit faster on level 2.
- **Score:** It's shown at the top left. Breaking a brick scores 10–30 points depending on its color, and hitting a 2-hit brick the first time scores 5.
- **Lives:** You start with 3, shown as hearts at the top right. Losing all of them ends the game, and you can restart from the "Game Over" screen.
- **Mouse:** Move the mouse to move the paddle. Click to start, launch the ball, go to the next level, or restart.
- **Keyboard:** ← → or A / D move the paddle. Space or Enter starts, launches the ball, goes to the next level, or restarts.

Where the ball hits the paddle sets the angle it bounces off at. The ball's speed is tied to the screen's refresh rate, so it will move faster on monitors running above 60 Hz.
